name: Pro Subscription Manager
description: Self-serve subscription console: plan card with seat usage, three-step change-plan wizard with exact proration preview, seat changes, pause/resume, cancel flow with reason-matched retention offers, upcoming invoice and billing timeline over a pluggable API.

props.name: api
props.description: Adapter: getSubscription, changePlan, updateSeats, pause, resume, cancel, acceptOffer, reactivate

props.name: plans
props.description: { id, name, rank, prices: { month, year } per seat, features, minSeats?, maxSeats?, legacy? }

props.name: retentionOffers
props.description: Offers shown in the cancel flow, matched to the chosen reason

props.name: usedSeats
props.description: Assigned seats; floor for seat reductions

props.name: queryClient
props.description: Share your app's TanStack Query cache
